why: Illya Koval's paper (Inventiones mathematicae, 2025, arXiv 2111.12171) proves a local version: an integrable perturbation of almost every ellipse (preserving integrability near the boundary) must itself be an ellipse, a case-restriction of the stated conjecture. The full conjecture remains open.
